name: temporal
description: Temporal reasoning over symbolic entities (Entity A, B, ...) and symbolic actions (Σ-link, Ω-lease, Ψ-seal, ...) written as plain prose: facts that start, end, expire, are renewed, replaced, corrected or only announced, with questions asked as of a given date.

cases.name: temporal_sigma_swap

text: A Σ-link joins exactly two entities, and an entity can be in only one Σ-link at a time.
On 10 January 2024, Entity A formed a Σ-link with Entity B.
A Σ-link joins exactly two entities, and an entity can be in only one Σ-link at a time.
On 20 February 2024, Entity A formed a Σ-link with Entity C.

cases.query: As of 1 March 2024, with which entity is Entity A Σ-linked? Answer with the entity's label only.

cases.name: temporal_omega_lease_expiry

text: An Ω-lease gives one entity temporary use of another, and it ends when its term runs out.
On 1 March 2024, Entity A took an Ω-lease on Entity B with a term of two weeks.
On 8 March 2024, Entity C took an Ω-lease on Entity D with a term of one month.

cases.query: As of 20 March 2024, which lessee still had a lease in force, Entity A or Entity C? Answer with the entity's label only.

cases.name: temporal_delta_token_relay

text: The Δ-token can be held by only one entity at a time.
On 1 April 2024, Entity A held the Δ-token, and on 9 April 2024 Entity A handed it to Entity B.
The Δ-token can be held by only one entity at a time.
On 15 April 2024, Entity B handed the Δ-token to Entity C.
The Δ-token can be held by only one entity at a time.
On 22 April 2024, Entity C handed the Δ-token back to Entity A. Entity D never held the Δ-token and only watched the relay.

cases.query: As of 30 April 2024, which entity held the Δ-token? Answer with the entity's label only.

cases.name: temporal_seal_lifted_resealed

text: A Ψ-seal stops an entity from acting for as long as it stays in place.
Entity A put a Ψ-seal on Entity B on 5 May 2024. Entity C lifted that Ψ-seal on 12 May 2024.
On 19 May 2024, Entity A put a Ψ-seal on Entity B again.

cases.query: As of 15 May 2024, was Entity B free to act? Answer FREE or SEALED.

cases.name: temporal_chair_succession

text: Entity Q is a Φ-council with a single chair. Entity A chaired Entity Q from 1 January 2023.
Entity Q is a Φ-council with a single chair. Entity B took over as chair of Entity Q on 1 September 2023, replacing Entity A.
Entity Q is a Φ-council with a single chair. Entity C became the chair of Entity Q on 1 June 2024, and Entity B stepped down the same day.

cases.query: As of 1 July 2024, who chairs Entity Q? Answer with the entity's label only.

cases.name: temporal_backfilled_history

text: A Σ-link joins exactly two entities, and an entity can be in only one Σ-link at a time.
Entity A has been Σ-linked to Entity B since 1 June 2024.
A Σ-link joins exactly two entities, and an entity can be in only one Σ-link at a time.
Entity A was Σ-linked to Entity C from 1 March 2024 until 1 June 2024.

cases.query: As of 15 April 2024, with which entity was Entity A Σ-linked? Answer with the entity's label only.

cases.name: temporal_restated_then_ended

text: A Σ-link joins exactly two entities, and an entity can be in only one Σ-link at a time.
On 5 January 2024, Entity A formed a Σ-link with Entity B.
A Σ-link joins exactly two entities, and an entity can be in only one Σ-link at a time.
Entity A is Σ-linked to Entity B, as it has been since January 2024.
A Σ-link joins exactly two entities, and an entity can be in only one Σ-link at a time.
Entity A and Entity B dissolved their Σ-link on 15 March 2024.

cases.query: As of 20 March 2024, was the Σ-link between Entity A and Entity B ACTIVE or DISSOLVED?

cases.name: temporal_derived_expiry

text: A Λ-grant is valid only while the entity that issued it holds a Λ-charter.
On 1 February 2024, Entity A issued Λ-grants to Entity B and to Entity C, and Entity A held a Λ-charter then.
On 1 April 2024, Entity D, who holds a Λ-charter, issued a Λ-grant to Entity E.
Entity A's Λ-charter was revoked on 1 July 2024.

cases.query: As of 1 August 2024, which entities held a valid Λ-grant? List their labels, then end the answer with COUNT=<number>.

cases.name: temporal_permit_windows

text: A Θ-permit counts only inside its stated window: not before it opens, not once it has closed.
On 1 March 2024, Entity A issued a Θ-permit to Entity B, effective from 1 April 2024 until 1 July 2024.
On the same day, Entity A issued a Θ-permit to Entity C, effective from 1 March 2024 until 15 March 2024.
Also on the same day, Entity A issued a Θ-permit to Entity D, effective from 15 March 2024 until 1 June 2024.

cases.query: As of 20 March 2024, which entities held an effective Θ-permit from Entity A? List their labels, then end the answer with COUNT=<number>.

cases.name: temporal_lease_extended

text: An Ω-lease gives one entity temporary use of another, and it ends when its term runs out.
Entity A took an Ω-lease on Entity B from 1 February 2024 until 1 March 2024.
An Ω-lease gives one entity temporary use of another, and it ends when its term runs out.
On 25 February 2024, the term of the Ω-lease of Entity A on Entity B was extended until 1 May 2024.

cases.query: As of 10 April 2024, was the Ω-lease of Entity A on Entity B ACTIVE or LAPSED?

cases.name: temporal_correction

text: A Σ-link joins exactly two entities, and an entity can be in only one Σ-link at a time.
On 1 March 2024, Entity A formed a Σ-link with Entity B.
A Σ-link joins exactly two entities, and an entity can be in only one Σ-link at a time.
Correction: the Σ-link formed on 1 March 2024 was between Entity A and Entity C, not Entity B. Entity A and Entity B were never Σ-linked.

cases.query: As of 15 March 2024, with which entity is Entity A Σ-linked? Answer with the entity's label only.

cases.name: temporal_partner_swap

text: A Σ-link joins exactly two entities, and an entity can be in only one Σ-link at a time.
Since 1 January 2024, Entity A had been Σ-linked to Entity C and Entity B to Entity D.
On 1 June 2024, both links were dissolved and, in the same hour, Entity A formed a Σ-link with Entity D, while Entity B formed one with Entity C.

cases.query: As of 1 July 2024, with which entity is Entity B Σ-linked? Answer with the entity's label only.

cases.name: temporal_mandate_until_event

text: A Ξ-mandate lasts until the entity that is named as its closer declares Ξ-completion.
Entity A received a Ξ-mandate over Entity B on 1 April 2024, and Entity C is its closer.
Entity C declared Ξ-completion on 20 April 2024.

cases.query: As of 1 May 2024, was the Ξ-mandate of Entity A over Entity B ACTIVE or CONCLUDED?

cases.name: temporal_announced_change

text: A Σ-link joins exactly two entities, and an entity can be in only one Σ-link at a time.
Entity A has been Σ-linked to Entity B since 1 February 2024.
On 1 May 2024, Entity A announced that it will form a Σ-link with Entity C on 1 September 2024, but until then the Σ-link with Entity B stays in place.

cases.query: As of 15 June 2024, with which entity is Entity A Σ-linked? Answer with the entity's label only.

cases.name: temporal_pass_regranted

text: A Ψ-pass lets an entity enter, and it counts only from the day it is granted until the day it is revoked.
Entity A granted Entity B a Ψ-pass on 15 January 2024.
A Ψ-pass lets an entity enter, and it counts only from the day it is granted until the day it is revoked.
Entity A revoked the Ψ-pass of Entity B on 10 February 2024.
A Ψ-pass lets an entity enter, and it counts only from the day it is granted until the day it is revoked.
Entity A granted Entity B a new Ψ-pass on 5 March 2024.

cases.query: As of 20 February 2024, did Entity B HOLD or LACK a valid Ψ-pass from Entity A?

cases.name: temporal_relative_dates

text: This report is dated 10 May 2024. A Σ-link joins exactly two entities, and an entity can be in only one Σ-link at a time.
Entity A formed a Σ-link with Entity B two weeks ago.
Entity C formed a Σ-link with Entity D the day before yesterday.
Entity E and Entity F, who formed a Σ-link in March 2024, dissolved it three days ago.

cases.query: Which Σ-link was formed most recently: the one of Entity A, of Entity C or of Entity E? Answer with the entity's label only.

cases.name: temporal_guild_membership

text: A Φ-guild has members, who join and leave it.
Entity A joined Entity Q on 1 January 2024 and left it on 15 February 2024.
Entity B joined Entity Q on 1 February 2024 and is still a member.
Entity C joined Entity Q on 1 March 2024 and left it on 15 April 2024.
Entity D joined Entity Q on 1 April 2024 and is still a member.

cases.query: As of 20 April 2024, which entities were members of Entity Q? List their labels, then end the answer with COUNT=<number>.

cases.name: temporal_board_replacements

text: The Φ-board of Entity Q has two seats. On 1 January 2024, Entity A and Entity B took the two seats of Entity Q.
The Φ-board of Entity Q has two seats. On 1 March 2024, Entity C took the seat of Entity A on Entity Q.
The Φ-board of Entity Q has two seats. On 1 May 2024, Entity D took the seat of Entity B on Entity Q.

cases.query: As of 10 May 2024, which entities sat on the Φ-board of Entity Q? List their labels, then end the answer with COUNT=<number>.

cases.name: temporal_lease_overlap_boundary

text: An Ω-lease gives one entity temporary use of another, and it ends when its term runs out.
Entity A held an Ω-lease on Entity B from 1 February 2024 until 1 April 2024.
Entity C held an Ω-lease on Entity D from 1 March 2024 until 1 May 2024.
Entity E held an Ω-lease on Entity F from 1 April 2024 until 1 June 2024.

cases.query: Which lease overlapped in time with the lease of Entity A, the one of Entity C or the one of Entity E? A lease that starts on the day another ends does not overlap it. Answer with the entity's label only.

cases.name: temporal_mixed_state_chain

text: A Σ-link joins exactly two entities, and an entity can be in only one Σ-link at a time.
An Ω-lease gives one entity temporary use of another, and it ends when its term runs out.
A Ψ-seal stops an entity from acting for as long as it stays in place.
On 1 January 2024, Entity A formed a Σ-link with Entity B.
On 1 January 2024, Entity C took an Ω-lease on Entity D until 1 April 2024.
On 1 January 2024, Entity E put a Ψ-seal on Entity F.
A Σ-link joins exactly two entities, and an entity can be in only one Σ-link at a time.
On 15 February 2024, Entity A broke its Σ-link with Entity B and formed a Σ-link with Entity G.
A Ψ-seal stops an entity from acting for as long as it stays in place.
Entity E lifted the Ψ-seal on Entity F on 10 March 2024.
An Ω-lease gives one entity temporary use of another, and it ends when its term runs out.
On 20 March 2024, the Ω-lease of Entity C on Entity D was renewed until 1 July 2024.

cases.query: As of 1 May 2024, which of these were in force: the Σ-link of Entity A, the Ω-lease of Entity C, the Ψ-seal of Entity E? Name the entities that were the subject of each one in force, then end the answer with COUNT=<number>.
